caption: Rhine Falls, Schaffhausen
composition: Rhine Falls from the north bank, with the mid-river rock and Schloss Laufen · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Rhine Falls spreads wide across the river, breaking around the central rock, with Schloss Laufen on the south cliff and Schloss Wörth on the near side. Existing visitor railings belong to the real viewpoint and are not expanded into new scaffolding. Spray and gray water match a cloudy afternoon. The Open-Meteo model is overcast and windy, with no rain.
